text: Home Depot named CFO Richard McPhail as incoming CEO, Ann-Marie Campbell as president and COO, and Jordan Broggi as incoming CFO. Outgoing CEO Ted Decker retains the board chairmanship. Q3 revenue rose 4.9% YoY to $43.4 billion, with comparable sales up 2.2%.

meta.note: Appointments are announced but not yet effective; earnings provide concurrent operating context.

text: Disney announced a $3 billion cost-savings target by FY2029, including workforce and administrative reductions, alongside projected FY2027 content spending of $26 billion, up 9%. Q4 revenue rose 16% YoY to $25.95 billion, with growth across experiences, entertainment and sports.

meta.note: Cost savings and content allocations are announced targets; Q4 results include an additional fiscal week.

text: CoreWeave and Nebius shares have each declined more than 50% over three months. Debt-financed neocloud infrastructure operates within an AI ecosystem supported by Nvidia's extensive financing arrangements, which are under increased investor scrutiny.

meta.note: Eisman's projected financing withdrawal and construction restrictions remain unverified scenarios.

text: Anthropic's IPO pricing is reportedly indicated above its $70-$78 range, with order books still open. Nine-month revenue reached $33.24 billion, up approximately 1,200% YoY, against a $104 billion net loss, predominantly comprising convertible notes and derivative liability revaluations.

meta.note: Above-range pricing remains unconfirmed; reported net losses predominantly reflect fair-value adjustments.

text: U.S. homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low of 25, with buyer traffic at 16. The 30-year mortgage rate reached 7.51% amid elevated energy, material and labor costs. Price reductions covered 46% of surveyed builders, with 68% offered sales incentives.

meta.note: Sentiment and buyer traffic indices do not directly measure realized construction activity.
